engine_protocol.description:
Wire protocol the pack's engine speaks (`"ariad-engine/1"` or `"ariad-engine/2"`).
Absent means `"ariad-engine/1"`. Install and resolve refuse a pack whose value differs
from the protocol the host registers for the engine of the same name.

license.description: SPDX licence summary of everything the pack contains.

name.description: Pack name: lower-case ASCII letters, digits and `-`, starting with a letter.

notices.description: Licence and notice files inside the install root, as relative paths.

requires_ashift.description: SemVer requirement on the `ashift` version that may install and run this pack.

Component.description: One downloadable file of a pack build.

dest.description: Directory inside the install root that receives the content (`.` for the root).

entries.description: Number of entries (files, directories and links) inside an archive.

executable.description: For `unpack = "file"`: mark the installed file executable.

name.description: Component name, unique within its target.

sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the downloaded file.

size.description: Size of the downloaded file in bytes.

unpacked_size.description: Sum of the regular file sizes inside an archive.

url.description: `https://` URL, or a path relative to the manifest's location.

Target.description: One platform build of a pack.

components.description: Files that make up this build.

entrypoint.description:
Engine argv. The first element is a path relative to the install root; later elements
may contain `{root}`.

env.description: Allow-listed engine environment variables; values may contain `{root}`.

executables.description:
Executable paths inside archive components, relative to the install root.
When absent or empty, resolve allows only `entrypoint[0]` and `unpack = "file"`
components with `executable = true`.

options.description: Default request options for the engine; string values may contain `{root}`.

triple.description: Rust target triple of the pack's binaries, e.g. `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`.
